text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen extends an invitation
to Ikuno
Dictus, and the two of them
head out together to
buy some training
cleats.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um, just for my own information, where
might I
find cleats designed to help
people get trim?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if that's what you're looking for,
then I know
just the—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... I'm sorry. Actually, I think
you'd be
better off asking a staff
member.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Are you feeling under the weather
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, it's nothing like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Then I'd very much like you to continue.
Please,
tell me everything you know
about cleats!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I can't. When it comes to cleats, I lose all
restraint
and tend to babble on without
realizing it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If that's what you're worried about, I
think I can
be of assistance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If I feel that you're going on and on, I
shall
intervene and stop you. What do
you think?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
But I don't want to cause you any
hassle...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Whatever do you mean? Think of all the
times I
reach for dessert when I'm trying
to watch my
diet. Or when I'm about to
stay up too late
watching baseball.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When I'm struggling to exercise
restraint, who is it
that always
intervenes? It's you, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Well... I suppose that's true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'd like an opportunity to
repay the
favor every now and then.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If you put it that way... Let's get started.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So, you're looking for training cleats
specially
designed to help you get trim...
Is that correct?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I'm sorry. Was I rambling all of a
sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Not at all. In fact, that's the side of
you I want
to see, Ikuno! Do continue!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Well, there are several sets of cleats
like that
in that corner over there. Why
don't we take a
look?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
N-now hold on, cut me a little slack
here!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Stay put, McQueen. It's time for your
cleat check!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Oh, McQueen... Look at these...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Since I chose these cleats myself, I have
a duty to
stay close to you at all times
and make sure you
stay safe!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well, if I had to say... I guess it's because
I was
happy when someone did it for me.
choice_data_list: どうしてそこまでするの？

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My legs were weak when I was a child,
so a
certain cleat-fitter made a pair of
cleats
especially for me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And for the same reason I mentioned
earlier, that
cleat-fitter stayed close to
me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Their attitude and enthusiasm were just
so cool...
I felt like I wanted to be just
like that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...This is the first time I've heard about
this.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I just—I was rambling again,
wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, you weren't. That was a wonderful
story. In
fact, I'd like to hear more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how about this? In exchange for
undergoing
your cleat check, I'd like to
hear more of your
stories.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You want to hear my stories?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If we're going to be close, we need
to get to
know one another, don't you
think?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh! ...That's true. I see. I doubt my
stories will be
especially riveting, but I
hope you enjoy them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I'll be counting on you. For the stories and the cleats.
